messages:
maya: Heads-up — sketch for a compact Roles view + a new visibility filter dropdown. Trying to address noisy orgs where admins only care about SSO-enforced seats. pic: https://img.redwood.test/ux/roles-compact.png maya: Two quick UX asks: 1) add a filter: All / SSO enforced / Invited / Active. 2) show a lightweight badge and inline hint in the invite drawer when org SSO is enforced. sam: Love the filter. Can we also make the filter state persist per-user? customers asked for it. :eyes: maya: yea planning to persist in local settings per-user. server side later if helpful for teams. alex: minor nit on the compact rows — the role name truncation feels aggressive on 1280px. Maybe reduce left padding and let name wrap to two lines instead of ellipsizing. maya: good call. i’ll try two-line wrap and tighter padding. priya: About the invite drawer hint — we should avoid modal-blocking warnings. propose inline microcopy: "Org SSO enforced — invites will require SSO activation" with a ? tooltip linking to docs. keep it subtle (80% opacity). sam: Agree. Also if SSO is enforced and a non-sso user is invited, we should show a small inline validation on the email field before submit. e.g. red underline + helper text: "This account must join via SSO." maya: mockup updated: added helper text + small shield icon. viewing: https://img.redwood.test/ux/invite-hint-v2.png ethan: Accessibility nit: tooltips need keyboard focus and aria-describedby mapping. For the shield icon, add aria-label and ensure the helper text is reachable by screen readers. maya: noted. thinking aria-describedby="#sso-hint" and for the tooltip role="tooltip" with tabindex=0 on the icon. sample: ```
Org SSO is enforced. Invited users must sign in with SSO.
``` priya: That works but prefer aria-live for dynamic validation messages on the email field (polite). alex: On audit log nav — current designs required too many clicks to jump to related events. Can we add a quick-jump mini-panel in the event detail with links: "View related invites (3)" / "Jump to user activity"? keeps people in context. maya: yeah adding a related-events quick panel in the right rail. compact links, timestamp + small counts. not a full redesign, just contextual links. sam: One more practical ask — add a keyboard shortcut to toggle the visibility filter (e.g., `f` then `s` for SSO). small power-user win. maya: I’ll add to the keyboard shortcuts doc and add a visual hint on hover. design-bot: Reminder: run color contrast check on the new badge colors. current orange (#f2a84b) fails AA on 12px labels. Suggest #d98220 or increase weight. maya: thanks — will update badge palette and re-run checks. ethan: Quick QA checklist for the team: keyboard nav for drawer, tooltip focus, aria-live for validation, contrast for badges, persist filter state. ping me when ready for pass. maya: putting a PR up later today with mocks + a small prototype. thanks all :thumbsup: sam: excited — great direction. priya: thank you! maya: (thread closed)
